units: Bytes are powers of 1024; all configuration values positive safe integers; defaults and ceilings exact

boundaryProtocol.meaning: For each row bind a deterministic independent generator/ledger achieving these charged values against local limit L. Admit <=L, reject before first excess allocation/read/publication as applicable. Zero successful truncation.
boundaryProtocol.defaults: Default-scale targets are recipes only, not materialized here. Lowered-limit controls do not prove default boundaries.
boundaryProtocol.hardCeilings: Validate H-1/H/H+1 configuration separately; positive safe <=H accepted (subject to other valid options), >H rejected before I/O with RangeError Invalid xan limit: <name>. H=2 depth has no invented depth-3 grammar.
boundaryProtocol.unreachable: If grammar or another approved cap prevents isolated target, record NOT_REACHABLE with exact binding; never count as success. B01-dependent selector cases remain blocked.
boundaryProtocol.errors:
Runtime limit failure status 1; exact xan <subcommand>: <limitName> limit exceeded
 only when entire diagnostic fits remaining local AND parent output budget; otherwise no emergency bytes.
boundaryProtocol.cumulative: No reset across files, skipped rows, selector resolution, serialization or diagnostic destinations; retained occupancy refunds only actual release. Parent always wins.
boundaryProtocol.timing: Cancellation at most 4096 work units between checks plus each awaited I/O; cooperative yield at most 65536 units, not a wall/RSS guarantee.
boundaryProtocol.cost: At most one streamed recipe at a time; <=60 seconds per default-scale attempt within authorized batch wall cap. Abort/teardown incomplete attempts, preserve NOT_EXECUTED/INCOMPLETE rather than pass.

rows.name: maxArgs
rows.recipe: headers -j plus N distinct short file operands: count=2+N; admit input-file override <=256. Hard-scale runtime witness may be unreachable under cardinality; do not invent repeated flags.

rows.name: maxArgumentBytes
rows.unit: sum UTF-8 bytes of argv; reject unpaired surrogates
rows.recipe: select plus one long valid header-name selector: six command bytes plus N selector bytes; matching header exists. Raise selector-byte cap only within its hard ceiling; hard-scale witness may be constrained.

rows.name: maxInputFiles
rows.recipe: headers -j over N distinct one-header files; use defaults for N=15,16,17; all bytes/effects independently enumerated.

rows.name: maxInputBytes
rows.recipe: stream ASCII rows of 1024 bytes (1023 a then LF), then one remainder; count permits ragged final width. Partition <=65536; independent sum is exact; no stored giant payload.

rows.name: maxChunks
rows.recipe: N-1 empty deliveries followed by one a+LF delivery; delivered count=N and count output 0+LF if admitted.

rows.name: maxChunkBytes
rows.unit: full borrowed delivery length, independent of owned occupancy
rows.recipe: one delivery of repeated 16 ASCII digits plus LF, then remainder; count avoids width constraint. Ensure records/input/work caps do not bind first.

rows.name: maxRecordBytes
rows.unit: raw record syntax excluding final LF/CRLF, not embedded terminators
rows.recipe: one count record of target bytes split by commas into cells below cell cap; add terminal LF outside target; stream <=65536-byte chunks.

rows.name: maxCellBytes
rows.unit: raw cell syntax including quotes/embedded line endings, excluding separators
rows.recipe: count one ASCII cell of target bytes plus LF; second quoted variant reserves two quote bytes and counts doubled quotes explicitly; keep record/chunk caps separate.

rows.name: maxColumns
rows.unit: all fields including trailing empty fields
rows.recipe: count record with N-1 commas and N short cells; trailing-empty variant same field count; other caps slack.

rows.name: maxRecords
rows.unit: all parsed nonblank logical records including header/template/skipped rows
rows.recipe: h+LF then N-1 copies x+LF; count header mode output N-1 plus LF; no blank-line substitution.

rows.name: maxSelectorBytes
rows.recipe: select one valid name of N ASCII bytes matched by header; argv budget raised within cap; output/retained bytes separately admitted.

rows.name: maxSelectorNodes
rows.recipe: bounded valid numeric-list/occurrence recipes, with independent node ledger after B01 resolution; do not assume one token equals one node or derive expected count from production parser.

rows.name: maxSelectorDepth
rows.unit: list depth 1, clause depth 2; no recursive grammar
rows.recipe: depth-2 legal selector against configured depth 1/2; configuration 3 fails above hard ceiling. No legal depth-3 input is invented; unreachable runtime L+1 is NOT A PASS.

rows.name: maxSelectedColumns
rows.recipe: select a bounded repeated numeric column list; independently sum emitted positions; selector bytes/nodes may bind earlier and require permitted overrides.

rows.name: maxLastRows
rows.unit: both requested positive tail size and occupied ring
rows.recipe: slice -L N with N tiny data records and a header; request L+1 rejects before reads, within bound emits after EOF; -L0 is separately Z01/Z02, not a positive override.

rows.name: maxWork
rows.unit: each inspected/compared byte, emitted index and copied/decoded/encoded/output byte; repeats charge again
rows.recipe: independent trace ledger of scanner/selector/copy/output events, split-phase cumulative stress; requires implementation observability binding, no new public hook. Input length is not a work proxy.

rows.name: maxOutputBytes
rows.unit: aggregate reserved stdout/stderr/file bytes including quoting/LF/diagnostics
rows.recipe: admitted repeated-column serialization with exact independent output-size arithmetic; bounded count/digest sink, not retained whole-output collection; parent/selector/retained constraints must be disclosed.

rows.name: maxRetainedBytes
rows.unit: simultaneous owned buffer capacity +2/UTF16 unit +8/index slot +32/node/span/ring slot
rows.recipe: independent capacity ledger for header/ring/scratch/fallback segments and assembly old+new+final buffer; borrowed incoming storage/provider allocation excluded from owned tally, not called unbounded-safe.
